messages:
marta: Heads-up — I'm planning an RBAC change for BYOK workflows to tighten who can request emergency rotations. Posting the proposed checklist here for comment.

sam: thanks, can you call out impact on audit logs ingest? SIEM team needs consistent fields to correlate rotation events.

olivia: +1 on SIEM. also need to confirm HSM attestation event surfaces in our audit stream. Right now the rotation flow produces two logs: `key.rotation.requested` and `key.rotation.completed` but no attestation.

jia: @olivia we can add attestation if the HSM proxy emits `attestation.cert_serial` — but that requires the proxy to sign and forward the attestation blob. Any objections from legal? @legal

legal: as long as the attestation payload excludes customer key material and only includes metadata (serial, firmware version, signing cert fingerprint), we're good. Keep retention to the compliance policy (7 years for certain customers).

marta: proposed RBAC diff: remove `rotate_key` from broad `platform-ops` role; add `key-rotation` role granted via short-lived grant from `security-approver` group. Emergency rotations use `ephemeral-rotation` token that expires in 15m.

sam: sounds reasonable. For rollouts we should have a canary policy: allow rotation in non-prod & a single customer in prod before global. Also add automated SIEM alert on any rotation > 1 per key per 24h.

oncall: quick note — during last incident we saw a rotation that had no `request_id` in logs which made tracing a pain. Can we standardize on `request_id` + `trace.parent` to match rest of infra?

marta: agreed. new log schema (minimal) I'm proposing: 
```json
{"ts":"<iso>", "event":"key.rotation.requested", "key_id":"arn:krm:...", "request_id":"<uuid>", "actor":"marta", "role_grant":"ephemeral-rotation", "hsm_attestation_serial":"<serial|null>", "fw_version":"<v>", "region":"us-west-2"}
```
Include identical fields on `key.rotation.completed` with `duration_ms` and `result`.

olivia: SIEM note — we need `request_id` in the log body AND as `X-Request-Id` header on the rotation API so frontends and proxies propagate it. If any component drops headers, correlation breaks.

sam: devops impact: HSM proxy needs a small change to forward attestation metadata and set header. Example CLI for devs for an emergency rotation:
```bash
kmsctl rotate --key arn:krm:acct:us-west-2:key/abcd1234 --reason "suspected compromise" --request-id $(uuidgen) --ephemeral-token $EPHEM
```
The proxy will emit `key.rotation.requested` immediately and `key.rotation.completed` after it verifies chunk uploads.

jia: vuln triage item — our security scanner flagged HSM proxy container base image with outdated libssl. We should treat as P2 for now; schedule rebuild + canary deploy. If firmware on HSM is also flagged, coordinate with vendor — but do not rotate keys pre-approval from vendor unless compromise confirmed.

marta: action items I captured: 
- jia: rebuild proxy image with latest libs and add attestation forwarding (ETA 48h)
- sam/devops: add `request_id` header propagation and SIEM mapping (ETA 72h)
- olivia: update logging schema and retention mapping in the logging playbook (ETA 24h)
- legal: confirm retention/attestation policy finalized (ETA 48h)
- oncall: add SIEM alert rule for >1 rotation per key / 24h and missing `hsm_attestation_serial` on prod rotations (ETA 24h)

oncall: I'll stub the alert in Datadog and link to the incident runbook.

marta: one more question — during emergency rotations, should we preserve the old key for escrow/forensics or immediate zeroization? thoughts?

legal: default preserve forensics copy encrypted under @legal-keystore until legal sign-off unless there's explicit regulatory requirement to zeroize (banking / government customers may require zeroize). Track decisions in ticket.

sam: operationally preserve a snapshot but isolate it and mark as `forensics-only`; add extra audit flag `forensics_locked:true`.

olivia: I'll update the runbook snippet to include both flows. Sample runbook step: 
```
1) Acquire ephemeral token
2) Run kmsctl rotate with --request-id
3) Wait for `key.rotation.completed` and check `hsm_attestation_serial`
4a) If compromise suspected => tag old key `forensics_locked:true` and escalate to legal
4b) If confirmed benign => schedule zeroize after 30 days
```

marta: thanks all. I'll open the RBAC PR and link these notes. ping me for reviews. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: deploy pipeline queued for `proxy-image` rebuild; build #782 -> canary
